dimensions.name: Autonomous operations
dimensions.blocker: Premium output now clears a materially stronger certification gate in controlled runs, but a clean unattended customer-style run from intake through delivery is still not proven.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: Main is green and the full suite is clean, but normal proof work still exposes integration and behavioral defects quickly enough that same-day repair remains part of the operating pattern.

dimensions.name: Customer fulfillment
dimensions.blocker: The purchase-to-billing chain exists and current internal pages can clear the delivery gate, but there is still no verified paid external end-to-end completion.

dimensions.name: AI / agent capability
dimensions.blocker: The creative agent path now produces certifiable work, but recent progress still depended on operator-led diagnosis and prompt/gate repair rather than demonstrated unattended convergence.

dimensions.name: Website Builder maturity
dimensions.blocker: The quality system is substantially stronger and current internal examples clear the reference-family delivery gate, but repeatable customer production and paid external fulfillment remain unproven.

dimensions.name: Acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: No repeatable acquisition or lead-to-paid conversion loop is proven, and the public company still reports no customers.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: No verified paying Stromation customers or recurring revenue exist yet; the venture portfolio remains parked and its last property retired.

changed: The single biggest change is the Website Builder's quality breakthrough from a poorly calibrated numeric scorer and a 7.80 direct-builder ceiling to a reference-family delivery system calibrated on real elite pages. Main now derives accessibility from evidence, captures real mobile/tablet/desktop contexts, rejects invalid captures and fabricated proof, resamples close comparisons, and judges craft against the hardest resolved family reference. Current Merritt & Vance and Emberline results clear that gate. This raises Website Builder and commercial confidence materially, while autonomy remains well below technical maturity because the path to that result was still operator-led rather than a clean unattended customer run.
method: Expanded independent forecast grounded in Sep. 14-15 main-branch merges through PR #174, the clean 5,845-test suite, green current Railway status, current generated purchase-to-billing implementation state, latest internal Website Builder certification evidence, the public offer/no-customer disclosure, parked venture status, and explicit absence of verified recurring revenue. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
